en.sayed-ali-raza: Allāh deputed the Prophet with a sparkling light, a clear argument, an open path and a guiding book.
His tribe is the best tribe and his lineal tree the best lineal tree whose branches are in good proportion and fruits hanging (in plenty).
His birth-place was Mecca, and the place of his immigration Ṭaybah (Medina), from where his name rose high and his voice spread far and wide.
